name: Fire Risk Assessment (FRA)
source_key_fields: Building address | Date | Assessor name and qualification | Scope | Significant findings | Persons at risk | Existing precautions | Action plan (High / Medium / Low priority) | Completion dates | Review date | Assessor signature
frequency: Annual review minimum; after significant material change; no fixed statutory expiry
issuing_body: Qualified fire risk assessor — IFSM, IFE, FPA, or BAFE SP205 membership recommended

name: Fire Alarm System Service Certificate
source_key_fields: Site address | System type/grade | Panel ID | Date | Engineer name/BAFE no. | Zones tested | Faults (C1/C2) | Remedial actions | Client signature | Next service due
frequency: Quarterly inspection; 6-monthly or annual full service per BS 5839-1
issuing_body: BAFE SP203-1 registered firm or NSI/SSAIB-approved company

name: Emergency Lighting Test Certificate
source_key_fields: Site | Test date | Test type (monthly/annual) | Luminaire count | Duration achieved | Failures | Pass/Fail | Remedial actions | Next test due
frequency: Monthly flick test (self-test log); Annual 3-hour duration test
issuing_body: NICEIC/NAPIT-registered electrician or specialist fire systems firm

name: Sprinkler / Suppression System Annual Test Certificate
source_key_fields: Site | System type | Date | Inspector name/BAFE no. | Pressure test | Flow switch test | Control valve positions | Deficiencies | Corrective actions | Next inspection
frequency: Quarterly checks; Annual main test; 5-yearly full trip test
issuing_body: BAFE SP101 / LPS 1048-registered suppression contractor

name: Fire Door Inspection Report
source_key_fields: Building | Door ID/location | Inspector cert no. | Date | Gap measurements | Seal condition | Closer function | Hold-open device | Signage | Ironmongery | Pass/Refer/Fail | Priority (Urgent/Routine)
frequency: HRBs: quarterly (communal doors), annual (flat entrance doors). Other commercial: annual
issuing_body: Certificated inspector — BWF-CERTIFIRE, BM TRADA Q-Mark, or FDIS trained

name: Electrical Installation Condition Report (EICR)
source_key_fields: Client name/address | Inspector name, qualification, NICEIC/NAPIT no. | Inspection date | Scope/limitations | Observations: C1 (danger) / C2 (potentially dangerous) / C3 (improvement) / FI (further investigation) | Overall: Satisfactory / Unsatisfactory | Next inspection due | Signatures
issuing_body: NICEIC Approved Contractor / NAPIT / ECA member firm

name: Electrical Installation Certificate (EIC) — new/modified installations
optional: Test results (insulation resistance, continuity, earth fault loop impedance, RCD test times)
source_key_fields: Client | Description of installation | Design/construction/inspection signatures | Circuit schedule | Test results (insulation resistance, continuity, earth fault loop impedance, RCD test times) | Date | Contractor NICEIC/NAPIT no.
frequency: On completion of any new or significantly altered electrical installation
issuing_body: NICEIC / NAPIT / ECA-registered contractor

name: Portable Appliance Testing (PAT) Register
source_key_fields: Asset ID | Description | Location | Serial no. | Test date | Earth continuity (Ω) | Insulation resistance (MΩ) | Pass/Fail/Withdrawn | Next test due | Tester name and signature
frequency: Risk-based — annually for most commercial environments
regulation: Electricity at Work Regulations 1989; IET Code of Practice for In-Service Inspection
issuing_body: Competent person with City & Guilds 2377 or equivalent

name: Gas Safety Certificate — Commercial (CP17)
source_key_fields: Property address | Appliance description/location | Gas Safe registration no. | Date | Inlet pressure (mbar) | Heat input (kW) | Burner pressure | Flue flow test | CO/CO2 readings | Safety device operation | Safe to use: Yes/No | Remedial actions | Engineer signature | Next check due
frequency: Annual — must not lapse
regulation: Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998 (SI 1998/2451) HSE minimum fields HSE: what a gas safety record must contain
issuing_body: Gas Safe registered engineer (mandatory by law)

name: Boiler Service Record
optional: Combustion analysis (CO, CO2, flue temp, efficiency %)
source_key_fields: Boiler make/model/serial no. | Location | Service date | Tasks completed | Parts replaced | Combustion analysis (CO, CO2, flue temp, efficiency %) | Fault codes cleared | Gas Safe no. | Engineer signature | Next service due
frequency: Annual minimum; some manufacturers require 6-monthly
regulation: Gas Safety Regulations 1998; Manufacturer maintenance requirements
issuing_body: Gas Safe registered engineer

name: Legionella Risk Assessment
source_key_fields: Site | Date | Assessor name/LCA no. | Water system description | Risk rating (High/Medium/Low) | Population at risk | Significant hazards | Control measures | Recommended actions | Responsible person | Monitoring scheme | Review date
frequency: Every 2 years or after significant system change or incident
regulation: ACOP L8 (4th ed); COSHH 2002 (SI 2002/2677) HSG274 HSE Technical Guidance Parts 1-3
issuing_body: Competent assessor — LCA registered company strongly recommended

name: Legionella Monitoring Log / Water Treatment Records
source_key_fields: Date | Outlet reference | Temperature reading (°C) | Target met Y/N | Flushing duration | Biocide dose/concentration | Chlorine residual (mg/L) | Technician name/signature | Corrective action | Next date
frequency: Monthly temperature monitoring; Weekly flushing; Treatment dosing as scheme requires
issuing_body: Water treatment contractor or trained in-house person

name: Cold Water Storage Tank Inspection Certificate
source_key_fields: Site | Tank ID/location | Capacity (litres) | Inspection date | Lid/screen/valve condition | Water clarity | Debris/sediment | Lining condition | Insulation | Temperature (°C) | Sample taken Y/N | Chlorination Y/N | Remedial actions | Technician signature
frequency: Annual visual inspection; full clean and disinfection every 1-2 years per risk assessment
regulation: ACOP L8; Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999 (SI 1999/1148)
issuing_body: LCA-registered water hygiene company

name: Written Scheme of Examination (WSE) & Pressure Vessel Inspection Certificate
source_key_fields: Site | System description | Vessel ID/serial no. | MAWP (bar) | Design temperature | Fluid | Last exam date | Exam type (external/internal/hydraulic) | Defects found | Safe operating limits | Next exam due | Competent person name/body/signature
frequency: As defined in WSE — typically 12-26 months for heating and hot water vessels
regulation: Pressure Systems Safety Regulations 2000 (SI 2000/128) HSE Guidance HSG261; PSSR ACOP guidance
issuing_body: Competent person — Allianz Engineering, Lloyd's Register, Bureau Veritas, TÜV SÜD

name: LOLER Thorough Examination Report — Passenger / Goods Lift
optional: Parts examined (ropes, sheaves, buffers, safety gear, car, doors, electrics, overload)
source_key_fields: Site | Lift ID/serial no. | Lift type | SWL (persons/kg) | Exam date | Parts examined (ropes, sheaves, buffers, safety gear, car, doors, electrics, overload) | Defects/observations | Immediate danger Y/N | Remedy before next use Y/N | Next exam due | Competent person name/employer/qualification/signature
frequency: 6 months (lifts carrying persons); 12 months (goods lifts)
regulation: Lifting Operations and Lifting Equipment Regulations 1998 (SI 1998/2307) HSE Guidance L113 ACOP; HSE LOLER thorough examination guidance
issuing_body: Competent person — typically insurance-based inspection body (Allianz, Bureau Veritas, Lloyd's Register, TÜV SÜD)

name: Asbestos Management Survey Report
source_key_fields: Client/site | Survey type | Date | Surveyor name/UKAS no./P402 cert | Areas surveyed | ACM reference | Location | Material type | Sample ref | Condition | Surface treatment | Risk score | Management recommendation | Analyst name/UKAS no.
frequency: One-off survey with annual management plan review
regulation: Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012 (SI 2012/632); HSG264 HSE Guidance HSG264 — Asbestos: The survey guide
issuing_body: UKAS-accredited surveying organisation; individual with P402 competency

name: Asbestos Register (Living Document)
source_key_fields: Building address | ACM reference | Floor/area/room | Material description | Quantity | Condition (current) | Risk score | Management action | Survey reference | Last reinspection | Reinspection frequency | Action completed Y/N | Date | Notes
frequency: Continuously maintained; updated after any disturbance or reinspection
issuing_body: PM maintains; populated from survey reports

name: Energy Performance Certificate (EPC)
source_key_fields: Property address | EPC ref no. | Assessment date | Expiry date | Asset rating (A-G) and score | Typical energy cost | Main heating fuel | Building type/area | CO2 emissions rating | Primary energy use (kWh/m²/year) | Improvement recommendations | Assessor name and accreditation no.
frequency: Valid 10 years; current at every letting; MEES minimum EPC E (2023), proposed B by 2030
regulation: Energy Performance of Buildings Regulations 2012 (SI 2012/3118); MEES 2015 MEES Minimum Energy Efficiency Standards (England and Wales) Regulations 2015
issuing_body: Accredited Energy Assessor registered on CIBSE or Elmhurst scheme

name: Air Conditioning Inspection Report (TM44)
optional: AC system inventory (type, make, model, age, refrigerant, rated output)
source_key_fields: Property | Inspection date | Inspector name/CIBSE no. | AC system inventory (type, make, model, age, refrigerant, rated output) | Maintenance history | Controls assessment | Sizing assessment | Efficiency observations | Recommended measures | Certificate ref | Next inspection due
frequency: Every 5 years
regulation: Energy Performance of Buildings Regulations 2012 — Article 12; SI 2012/3118
issuing_body: CIBSE-registered Energy Assessor (Level 3 or 4 Non-Domestic)

name: Display Energy Certificate (DEC) — Public Buildings
source_key_fields: Property | DEC reference | Annual operational rating (A-G) | CO2 emissions (kg/m²/year) | Energy use breakdown | Benchmark comparison | Year of construction | Floor area | Assessor name/accreditation no. | Advisory report reference | Valid until
frequency: Operational rating: annual; Advisory report: every 7 years
regulation: Energy Performance of Buildings Regulations 2012 (public buildings >250m²)
issuing_body: Accredited Energy Assessor

name: ESOS Assessment Evidence Pack
source_key_fields: Organisation name | Companies House no. | ESOS notification reference | Phase | Compliance date | Lead assessor name/registration body | Energy audits completed (buildings, transport, industrial) | Total energy consumption (kWh by vector) | Opportunities identified | Estimated savings | Board director sign-off | Environment Agency notification reference
frequency: Every 4 years (Phase 3 deadline: December 2023)
issuing_body: ESOS Lead Assessor registered with CIBSE, Energy Institute, or IEMA

name: F-Gas Leak Check Certificate / Refrigerant Log
source_key_fields: Site | Equipment ID | Refrigerant type | Charge quantity (kg) | CO2e (tCO2e) | Check date | Leak detection method | Leaks found Y/N | Leak location | Repair action | Post-repair check result | Refrigerant added (kg) | Recovered (kg) | Company cert no. | Technician cert no. | Signature | Next check due
frequency: <5 tCO2e: annual; 5-50t: 6-monthly; >50t: 3-monthly; >500t: 3-monthly with ALD system
regulation: UK F-Gas Regulations 2022 (retained from EU 517/2014); SI 2015/310 as amended GOV.UK Guidance F-Gas guidance for engineers and refrigeration businesses
issuing_body: REFCOM-registered company; F-Gas certified technician (City & Guilds 2079)

name: Health & Safety Policy Statement
source_key_fields: Organisation name | Policy statement | Signed by (name, title, date) | Organisation structure | Responsibilities | Arrangements | Distribution list | Version | Review date
frequency: Annual review or following significant change
regulation: Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 (Section 2(3))

name: General Risk Assessment Register
source_key_fields: Activity/task | Hazard | Who might be harmed | Existing controls | Likelihood (1-5) | Severity (1-5) | Risk rating | Additional controls | Responsible person | Target date | Completion date | Residual risk | Assessor name | Date
frequency: Annual review; immediately after incident or significant change
regulation: Management of H&S at Work Regulations 1999 (SI 1999/3242); HSWA 1974

name: Employers' Liability Insurance Certificate
source_key_fields: Insured name | Policy number | Insurer name and FCA authorisation | Period of insurance (from/to) | Minimum indemnity (statutory minimum £5M) | Compliance statement | Insurer signature | Date | Instruction to display prominently
frequency: Annual renewal

name: Higher-Risk Building (HRB) Registration Certificate
source_key_fields: Unique Building Identifier (UBI) | Building name/address | PAP name/organisation | Building Manager name/contact | Number of floors | Height (m) | Number of residential units | Registration date | BSR reference | Compliance status
frequency: One-off registration; annual confirmation. Failure to register = criminal offence
regulation: Building Safety Act 2022; HRB Registration Regulations 2023 (SI 2023/270) BSR Building Safety Regulator — HRB registration guidance
issuing_body: Building Safety Regulator (BSR) — operated by HSE

name: Building Safety Case Report
source_key_fields: Building description/UBI | Structural fire safety assessment | Fire safety measures | Structural integrity evidence | Golden Thread information register | Safety management system | Residents engagement strategy | Identified risks and controls | PAP contact | Date/version
frequency: Living document — updated on significant change; submitted at registration and on BSR request
regulation: Building Safety Act 2022 (Sections 76-87); SI 2023/999 BSR Safety case report — what to include (HSE)

name: Gas Safe Registration Certificate (Company)
source_key_fields: Company name/trading name | Registered address | Gas Safe registration no. | Categories of work authorised | Expiry date | Conditions | Authorised signatories
frequency: Annual renewal — unregistered gas work is a criminal offence
issuing_body: Gas Safe Register (appointed by HSE as official registration body)

name: ACS Individual Competency Card (Gas Engineer)
optional: ACS competency codes (CCN1=core, CENWAT=central heating, CKR1=commercial kitchens)
source_key_fields: Engineer name/photo | Gas Safe card no. | Company | ACS competency codes (CCN1=core, CENWAT=central heating, CKR1=commercial kitchens) | Issue date | Expiry
frequency: 5-year renewal; engineer must carry card on all gas work
regulation: Gas Safety Regulations 1998; ACOP supporting competency framework
issuing_body: CATA / NACS / EUSR (certification bodies)

name: NICEIC Approved Contractor Certificate
source_key_fields: Company name | NICEIC roll number | Registration categories | Qualified Supervisor name/qualification | Assessment date | Expiry date
frequency: Annual assessment and renewal
issuing_body: NICEIC (National Inspection Council for Electrical Installation Contracting)

name: NAPIT Registration Certificate
source_key_fields: Company name | NAPIT member number | Competencies | Approved Inspector name | Issue date | Expiry
frequency: Annual
regulation: Electricity at Work Regulations 1989; Building Regulations Part P
issuing_body: NAPIT (National Association of Professional Inspectors and Testers)

name: City & Guilds 2382 — BS 7671 18th Edition Certificate
source_key_fields: Candidate name | Centre no. | Candidate no. | Qualification title (2382-22) | Units passed | Date | Certificate no. | Awarding body signature
frequency: Refreshed on each edition update (typically 5 years)
issuing_body: City & Guilds / EAL / BTEC

name: BAFE SP203-1 Registration Certificate
source_key_fields: Company name | BAFE registration no. | Scope (design/installation/commissioning/maintenance) | Scheme (SP203-1) | Audit date | Expiry date | Certification body
frequency: Annual audit; 3-year full reassessment
issuing_body: BAFE (British Approvals for Fire Equipment)

name: NSI Gold Certificate — Fire & Security Systems
source_key_fields: Company name | NSI number | Activities (fire alarm design, installation, maintenance) | Grade (Gold/Silver) | Expiry date
frequency: Annual audit
issuing_body: NSI (National Security Inspectorate)

name: BAFE SP101 — Fixed Gaseous Suppression Systems
source_key_fields: Company name | Registration no. | Systems covered (CO2, FM200, Inergen, Novec 1230) | Expiry date | Issuing body
frequency: Annual
issuing_body: BAFE / LPS 1048 (BRE Global)

name: LEIA Membership Certificate
optional: Assessed to LEIA Code of Practice
source_key_fields: Company name | LEIA member number | Category (installer/maintainer/repair/manufacturer) | Membership grade | Expiry date | Assessed to LEIA Code of Practice
frequency: Annual membership
regulation: LOLER 1998; PSSR 2000; Machinery Directive (retained UK law)
issuing_body: LEIA (Lift and Escalator Industry Association)

name: LOLER Competent Person / Inspection Body Authorisation
source_key_fields: Inspector name | Employer/inspection body | Authorisation scope (lift type, SWL range) | LOLER competency reference | Issue date | Authorised signature
issuing_body: Inspection bodies: Allianz Engineering, Bureau Veritas, Lloyd's Register, TÜV SÜD, SGS

name: HSE Asbestos Removal Licence (Licensed Contractor)
source_key_fields: Company name/address | Licence number | Licence holder | Scope | Conditions | Issue date | Expiry date | HSE signature
frequency: 3-year licence renewal
issuing_body: Health and Safety Executive (HSE) — issued per company

name: UKAS Accreditation Certificate — Asbestos Surveying & Testing
optional: Scope (fibre counting, bulk analysis, air sampling, survey)
source_key_fields: Organisation name | UKAS accreditation no. | Scope (fibre counting, bulk analysis, air sampling, survey) | Standard (ISO 17020/17025) | Accreditation date | Expiry | Assessment schedule
frequency: 4-year cycle; annual surveillance
issuing_body: UKAS (United Kingdom Accreditation Service)

name: Individual Asbestos Competency — P402 / P403 / P404
source_key_fields: Candidate name | Module (P402/P403/P404) | Date | Certificate no. | BOHS/RSPH membership no. | Issuing body signature
issuing_body: BOHS (British Occupational Hygiene Society) / RSPH

name: Legionella Control Association (LCA) Registration Certificate
source_key_fields: Company name | LCA registration no. | Scope (risk assessment/water treatment/tank cleaning/cooling tower cleaning) | Assessment date | Expiry date
frequency: Annual assessment and renewal
issuing_body: LCA (Legionella Control Association)

name: BTEC/BOHS Legionella Competency Certificate
source_key_fields: Candidate name | Award title | Level | Units completed | Date | Certificate no. | Awarding body | Registration no.
regulation: ACOP L8 — requires competent persons for risk assessment and water management
issuing_body: BOHS / Edexcel BTEC / WMSoc

name: F-Gas Company Certificate (REFCOM Registration)
source_key_fields: Company name | REFCOM registration no. | Activities (installation/maintenance/leak checking/recovery) | Nominated technician names/cert nos. | Registration date
frequency: Annual — must remain current
issuing_body: REFCOM (Register of Companies Competent to Handle Refrigerants)

name: Individual F-Gas Technician Certificate — City & Guilds 2079
source_key_fields: Candidate name | Certificate no. | Category (I/II/III/IV) | Refrigerants covered | Date of award | City & Guilds/ACRIB reference
regulation: UK F-Gas Regulations 2022 — mandatory for anyone handling fluorinated refrigerants
issuing_body: City & Guilds / ACRIB (Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Industry Board) Categories Category I: All equipment | Category II: Stationary <3kg | Category III: Hermetically sealed <6kg | Category IV: Recovery only

name: CHAS Premium Plus / SSIP Certificate
source_key_fields: Company name | SSIP member scheme | Certificate level | Scope of works assessed | Assessment date | Expiry date | Assessor body
frequency: Annual renewal
regulation: Health and Safety at Work Act 1974; CDM Regulations 2015
issuing_body: CHAS / Constructionline / SafeContractor / SMAS / Acclaim (all SSIP mutual recognition)

name: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Certificate
source_key_fields: Organisation name | Certificate no. | Scope | Certification body | Date of initial cert | Current cycle start | Expiry date | Issuing signatory | UKAS accreditation no.
frequency: 3-year cycle; annual surveillance audits
issuing_body: UKAS-accredited certification body (BSI, Bureau Veritas, NQA, SGS, Intertek)

name: ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management Certificate
source_key_fields: Organisation name | Certificate no. | Scope | Sites covered | Certification body | UKAS no. | Expiry date
frequency: 3-year cycle; annual surveillance
issuing_body: UKAS-accredited certification body

name: Contractors' Employers' Liability Insurance Certificate
source_key_fields: Insured name | Policy no. | Insurer name/FCA no. | Period | Minimum indemnity (£5M statutory minimum) | Date
frequency: Annual — PM must check annually for every contractor

name: Contractors' Public Liability Insurance Certificate
source_key_fields: Insured name | Policy no. | Insurer | Period | Indemnity limit per occurrence | Currency statement | Date
frequency: Annual — verify at contract renewal and annually during contract

name: SIA Approved Contractor Scheme (ACS) Certificate
source_key_fields: Company name | ACS score (%) | Activities covered (Manned Guarding/Door Supervision/CCTV/Cash and Valuables) | Audit date | Certificate expiry | SIA reference no.
frequency: Annual audit; ACS accreditation reviewed every 3 years
issuing_body: Security Industry Authority (SIA)

name: Individual SIA Licence
source_key_fields: Name/photo | Licence no. | Activity (Door Supervisor/Security Guard/CCTV Operator/Close Protection) | Issue date | Expiry | SIA logo
frequency: 3-year renewal; must be carried on duty at all times
regulation: Private Security Industry Act 2001 — mandatory for all frontline security operatives
issuing_body: SIA

name: NSI Gold Certificate — Security Systems (NACOSS Gold)
source_key_fields: Company name | NSI NACOSS Gold no. | Scope (intruder alarm/CCTV/access control) | Grade (Gold) | Expiry date
frequency: Annual audit
regulation: BS EN 50131 (intruder); BS EN 62676 (CCTV); BS EN 60839 (access control)
issuing_body: NSI (National Security Inspectorate)

name: BPCA Corporate Membership Certificate
optional: Audited to BPCA Code of Practice
source_key_fields: Company name | BPCA member no. | Category (full/associate member) | Expiry date | Audited to BPCA Code of Practice
frequency: Annual
issuing_body: BPCA (British Pest Control Association)

name: Individual Pesticide Application Certificate — PA1 + PA2 / PA6
source_key_fields: Name | Modules held | Certificate of Competence no. | Issuing body | Issue date | Expiry date | BASIS PROMPT registration no.
frequency: Certificate of Competence valid 5 years; CPD renewal via BASIS PROMPT Modules PA1: Foundation (mandatory for all) | PA2: Pedestrian applicator | PA6: Hand-held applicator — most common for urban pest control FM
issuing_body: Lantra Awards / City & Guilds / BASIS PROMPT register
